question: Will Strategy (MSTR) disclose any bitcoin purchase in a Form 8-K on Monday, July 27?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Strategy (ticker: MSTR) filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on Monday, July 27, 2026 (Eastern Time / ET) that discloses a bitcoin purchase — i.e., the filing explicitly states that the company acquired, purchased, or bought bitcoin during a specified period, as reported in SEC EDGAR.
- "No": Wins if no such Form 8-K was filed by Strategy on Monday, July 27, 2026 (Eastern Time / ET) disclosing a bitcoin purchase, as confirmed by SEC EDGAR.

Clarifications:
- The filing date on EDGAR must be July 27, 2026 (ET); 8-K filings submitted on other dates (even if describing activity occurring on July 27) do not satisfy the "Yes" condition.
- A Form 8-K/A (amendment) filed on July 27, 2026 (ET) that discloses a new bitcoin purchase counts toward "Yes."
- The filing must affirmatively disclose a completed bitcoin acquisition; a filing that merely discusses bitcoin holdings without disclosing a new purchase does not satisfy "Yes."
